name: Jersey Gardens
summary: Jersey Gardens is New Jersey's largest outlet shopping center, featuring over 200 brand-name outlet stores in an enclosed, climate-controlled environment. Located in Elizabeth near Newark Airport, it offers tax-free shopping on clothing and serves as a premier destination for value-conscious shoppers from across the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area.
demographics: Jersey Gardens attracts a diverse, value-conscious shopper base primarily from the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area, with a strong representation of middle-income families and young adults aged 25-45. The trade area draws heavily from urban and suburban communities within a 30-mile radius, including significant tourist traffic from Manhattan and international visitors seeking tax-free shopping in New Jersey. Shoppers are typically deal-seekers who appreciate the outlet format, with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000, and the center sees high weekend and holiday traffic from bargain hunters and families looking for brand-name merchandise at discounted prices.
description: Jersey Gardens, operated by Simon Property Group, stands as New Jersey's largest outlet and value retail shopping destination, offering an exceptional shopping experience just minutes from Newark Liberty International Airport. This enclosed outlet center has become a premier destination for savvy shoppers seeking designer and brand-name merchandise at significant discounts, all while enjoying New Jersey's tax-free shopping on clothing and footwear. The center features a diverse mix of over 200 outlet stores from popular brands, providing everything from fashion and accessories to home goods and electronics under one roof. With its convenient location off the New Jersey Turnpike in Elizabeth, Jersey Gardens serves as a major shopping hub for both local residents and tourists visiting the New York metropolitan area. The mall's climate-controlled environment, ample parking, and comprehensive dining options make it an ideal destination for a full day of shopping, consistently earning high ratings from visitors who appreciate the combination of value, variety, and convenience.
